title: Zine Machine
subtitle: One sheet. Eight pages. Your point of view.
description: An independent pocket-publishing studio with three original starter books, editable pages, expressive ink treatments, and real-size A4 or Letter sheet exports. Write a little, make one careful cut, and fold a book worth passing on.
instruction: Choose a starter, edit your eight pages, then download the SVG sheet and follow the folding guide.
